description: This file contains utility functions related to string formatting for unit counts and durations, likely used for logging or reporting purposes.

methods.name: str pluralize(count: int, singular_word: str, plural_word: str = "")
methods.description: Returns a string with the count and appropriate singular or plural form of a word.

methods.name: str duration_to_str(seconds: float)
methods.description: Converts a duration in seconds into a human-readable string with appropriate units (seconds, minutes, hours).

ctags.name: pluralize
ctags.pattern: /^def pluralize(count: int, singular_word: str, plural_word: str = "") -> str:$/
